title: Error Orbit and Dependency Backtrace Dashboard
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a new interactive dashboard and upstream dependency backtrace to help oncall and SREs rapidly attribute inference failures to the true origin (network, routing, runtime overload, model rejection / model crash, or downstream service). The visualization ("Error Orbit") places the service under investigation in the center and plots concentric rings of dependency categories (network, infra, runtime, model, external) with sized nodes representing failure volume and color encoding dominant failure mode. Backtrace panels show top-k causal paths derived from tracehooks and log/metric correlation. This ticket covers ingestion schema, tracehook enrichment, dashboard panels, and alert migration.
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry: traces include new span tags: error_signature, failure_mode, model_variant, request_size, kv_hit (boolean), route_policy
Logs: ingestion pipeline appends normalized failure_code and canonical_reason fields for all services (HTTP/gRPC/native runtime errors)
Backtrace: panel lists top-5 causal paths with probability scores and links to representative traces
Orbit visualization renders live for a selected service and time window, with filters for failure_mode and model_variant
Alerts: at least two example alerts migrated to use canonical failure fields (timeout and overload), and alert thresholds validated against historical SLO violations
tasks: Design telemetry schema and canonical failure vocabulary (TIMEOUT, OVERLOAD, MODEL_REJECT, MODEL_CRASH, HTTP_4XX, HTTP_5XX, GRPC_UNAVAILABLE, GRPC_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED)
Add tracehook enrichment: attach upstream_service_chain and model_variant to error spans (runtime team)
Metrics pipeline: update log-forwarder mapping rule to populate 'failure_mode' and 'failure_code' fields
Dashboard: build Error Orbit panels (front-end + queries) and dependency backtrace table
End-to-end test: simulate error scenarios (artificial timeouts, synthetic overload, model rejection) and validate representation
Documentation: Confluence spec + runbook snippets linking to example traces and remediation steps
technical_notes: Failure vocabulary must be compact and orthogonal to allow downstream aggregation and ML-based root-cause scoring.
We will enrich spans at the tracehook entry point (edge + routing) and at model runtime to capture model-specific error codes (e.g., rejection vs. OOM).
Backtrace derivation uses existing trace joiner service (small query over span parents) and a heuristic scorer: recent_error_rate * inverse_latency_p50 * path_length_penalty.
Sampling: raise trace sample rate to 100% for error-tagged requests for 15 minutes after an alert to capture causal chains (configurable per-route).
Storage: new fields added to ES/OLAP mapping; migration script to normalize historical failure_code values will run in a low-priority background job.
